The Peak Mini is a 1-person indoor full spectrum infrared sauna built for small rooms and apartments. It reaches a true 150°F, includes a full-body medical-grade red light panel as standard, runs from the Peak Saunas app, plugs into a standard 120V outlet, and ships free in a protective crate with a 7-Year Warranty.

Why people actually buy our saunas: the long game.

Regular sauna use is one of the most-studied longevity habits in the world. Researchers followed 2,315 middle-aged men for 20 years and found that those who used a sauna 4–7 times a week had 40% lower all-cause mortality and 50% lower fatal cardiovascular disease than once-a-week users (Laukkanen et al., JAMA Internal Medicine, 2015); a follow-up reported a 65% lower rate of Alzheimer's disease (Age and Ageing, 2017). The benefit tracked with frequency — which is the entire argument for owning a sauna instead of booking one. The Mini is built to make that frequency effortless: the smallest, simplest way to turn sauna use into a daily habit.

Mini — The 1-person, plug-and-play sauna.

The Mini brings a true full-spectrum infrared sauna — with real medical-grade red light — into spaces most cabins can't fit. It plugs into a standard household outlet, so there's no electrician and no dedicated circuit: unbox it, clasp it together, and step in.
